verdict.scope: Only explicitly tested full supplied Dockerfile scratch image in isolated synthetic local network-none execution under NO_MODEL; no broader product/release approval.

Q1.tested: Pinned full supplied image, permitted physical context/lock/source exact, scratch file closure including runtime and operational bundles/CLI; no shell/package manager. No dependency installation or rebuild performed. Build execution provenance comes from packet identity, not a new build attestation.

Q2.tested: Node v22.23.2; UID/GID10001; default direct PID1 Node main; exact runtime/offline bundle SHA256.

Q3.tested: Actual network none/no published ports, readonly rootfs, caps zero, no-new-privileges, 512MiB/64pids/1cpu; only explicitly owned /data application volume writable; /app write EROFS.

Q4.tested: Authenticated actual WAHA-format public webhook; help/raw NO_MODEL/manual exact-token confirmation, foreign/unknown token denial, multiple-draft bare-ok denial, non-manager denial, manager pause/resume, idempotency conflict. Only loopback WAHA send mock contacted; no model/Whisper HTTP requests; raw confirmations activate zero tasks.

Q5.tested: Healthy stop/start preserves journal bytes and accepted-send count; duplicate webhook returns accepted:false without new send. Restore retains originals, orphan synthetic binary and projection documents. Not all crash/uncertain/media/task states qualified.

Q6.tested: Second writer exits STORE_LOCKED before listener. Live same-size change, truncation, rename replacement, current manifest reference, manifest revision corruption and lock replacement: immediate webhook/readiness 503, zero new accepted POSTs and identical corrupt bytes. Health-first mutation independently 503. Held first POST plus queued second: healthy sends second; corruption prevents second and preserves bytes. Restart remains 503 or refuses residual replaced lock; truncation retains original and isolates tail. Delivered CLI inside scratch performs backup/restore with retention/hold and rejects invalid old journal even with superficial inventory hash recomputed. Restored actual main stays operational_hold 503 with no new sends.

Q7.tested: Only authority, permitted explicit technical source/context inputs, actual image and own synthetic outputs/volumes. No Root governance/ledger/history/reports/privateenv/keys reads; no Source/context writes; own-only Docker cleanup incl rm -v; no promotion.

limits: No independent Docker rebuild/provenance attestation; builds/install prohibited.
WAHA parser + loopback mock only; Evolution actual webhook/provider NOT_RUN.
No complete P01-P11/clinical fidelity/audio/production capacity certification.
No filesystem power-loss, malicious concurrent writer race exclusion or arbitrary timing proof.
Restart corruption observations verify readiness and bytes; receiver was not continuously alive across Docker stop/start.
mtime reset attempted in extra probe but nanosecond timestamp equality was not attained; no claim of exact mtime restoration.
